purpose: Resolve D+5 and D+10 forward economic returns for frozen V2.8.3 signal snapshots without mixing D-vintage and T-vintage price scales.

input_authorities.economic_price_rule: V2.6 D and T endpoints from the same T-vintage retained snapshot

maturity.target_dates: Use the D+5 and D+10 joint A-share trading dates frozen in the signal feature receipt.

T_vintage_selection.candidate_pin_window: strictly after T close and no later than T+1 23:59:59 Asia/Shanghai
T_vintage_selection.selection: earliest prospectively frozen source pin in that window whose exact materialized stock and benchmark scoped max_bar_date both equal T

economic_return.D_endpoint: source close for signal date D read from the exact selected T-vintage stock parquet
economic_return.T_endpoint: source close for target date T read from the same exact selected T-vintage stock parquet

population.security_set: exact D PIT universe frozen with the D signal feature receipt

outputs.per_horizon_csv: one immutable CSV per signal_date x horizon
outputs.per_horizon_receipt: one immutable JSON receipt per signal_date x horizon

problem_elimination.delete: No repeated D feature calculation at outcome time.
problem_elimination.avoid: Never combine a D-vintage D endpoint with a T-vintage T endpoint.
problem_elimination.absorb: Reuse exact source pins, joint calendar and frozen D PIT universe.
problem_elimination.substitute: Represent unavailable target bars explicitly instead of shifting targets.
problem_elimination.precompute_reuse: Within one resolver run, Hugging Face cache may reuse one T-vintage across multiple matured signal/horizon resolutions.
problem_elimination.optimize: No statistical computation is performed in this layer.
